definitionZh: 文本装饰风格的CSS属性设置了文本装饰线所指定的行的样式. 样式适用于所有设置有文字装饰线的行.
sourceDefinition: The text-decoration-style CSS property sets the style of the lines specified by text-decoration-line. The style applies to all lines that are set with text-decoration-line.
